'''Larry Alan Wasserman''' (born 1959) is a [[Canadians|Canadian]]-American [[statistician]] and a professor in the Department of Statistics & Data Science and the Machine Learning Department at [[Carnegie Mellon University]].

== Biography==
Wasserman received his Ph.D. from the [[University of Toronto]] in 1988 under the supervision of [[Robert Tibshirani]].

He received the [[COPSS Presidents' Award]] in 1999<ref name=copssAward>"Committee of Presidents of Statistical Societies: Presidents' Award: Past Award Recipients," National Institute of Statistical Sciences, accessed August 14, 2011, [http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/PastAwardsPresidents.pdf http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/PastAwardsPresidents.pdf] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150701092901/http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/PastAwardsPresidents.pdf |date=2015-07-01 }}.</ref> and the [[Centre de Recherches Mathématiques|CRM]]-[[Statistical Society of Canada|SSC]] Prize in 2002.<ref name=crm-sscPrize>"The 2002 CRM-SSC Prize is awarded to Larry Wasserman,"Centre de recherches mathématiques, accessed August 14, 2011, [http://www.crm.umontreal.ca/prix/prixCRM-SSC/2002_CRM-SSC_an.html http://www.crm.umontreal.ca/prix/prixCRM-SSC/2002_CRM-SSC_an.html].</ref>

He was elected a fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]] in 1996,<ref name=asaFellow>"ASA Fellows," American Statistical Association, accessed August 14, 2011, [http://www.amstat.org/careers/fellowslist.cfm http://www.amstat.org/careers/fellowslist.cfm] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200409223154/http://www.amstat.org/careers/fellowslist.cfm |date=2020-04-09 }}.</ref> of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 2004,<ref name=imsFellow>"IMS Fellows," Institute of Mathematical Statistics, accessed August 14, 2011, [http://www.imstat.org/awards/honored_fellows.htm http://www.imstat.org/awards/honored_fellows.htm] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140302125855/http://www.imstat.org/awards/honored_fellows.htm |date=2014-03-02 }}</ref> and of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] in 2011.<ref name=aaasFellow>{{cite web |url=http://www.aaas.org/news/2011/01/11/aaas-members-elected-fellows |title=AAAS Members Elected as Fellows (2010) |last1=AAAS.org staff report |first1=Larry |date=2012 |website=aaas.org |publisher=AAAS |accessdate=16 December 2014}}</ref> He was elected to [[National Academy of Sciences]] in May, 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2016/may/wasserman-elected-to-nas.html|title = Larry Wasserman Elected to National Academy of Sciences - News - Carnegie Mellon University}}</ref>

== Selected works==
Wasserman has  written many research papers about [[nonparametric inference]], asymptotic theory, causality, and applications of statistics to astrophysics, bioinformatics, and genetics. He has also written two advanced statistics textbooks, ''All of Statistics''<ref>Wasserman, Larry. ''All of Statistics: A Concise Course in Statistical Inference''. New York: Springer, 2004. {{ISBN|978-0-387-40272-7}}</ref> and ''All of Nonparametric Statistics''.<ref>Wasserman, Larry. ''All of Nonparametric Statistics''. New York: Springer, 2006. {{ISBN|978-0-387-25145-5}}</ref>

* 2004. ''All of Statistics: A Concise Course in Statistical Inference''. Springer-Verlag, New York. {{ISBN|978-0387402727}}
: won ''DeGroot Prize 2005''.<ref name=degrootPrize>{{cite web |url=http://bayesian.org/awards/DeGrootPrize.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010219192945/http://www.bayesian.org/awards/DeGrootPrize.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=2001-02-19 |title=Winners of the DeGroot Prize (2005) |last1=Wasserman |first1=Larry |date=2005 |website=bayesian.org |publisher=International Society for Bayesian Analysis |accessdate=16 December 2014 }}</ref> 
* 2006. ''All of Nonparametric Statistics''. Springer. {{ISBN|978-0-387-25145-5}}
* 2013. ''[http://www.stat.cmu.edu/~larry/talk.pdf Topological Inference]''. Rietz Lecture 2013.

==Honors and awards==
* 2016, Member of [[National Academy of Sciences]]
: Wasserman was elected to National Academy of Sciences in recognition of his distinguished and continuing achievement in original research.<ref>[https://www.cs.cmu.edu/news/larry-wasserman-elected-national-academy-sciences Larry Wasserman Elected To National Academy of Sciences]</ref>
